criteria.description: Agent operators can discover FIPS mesh nodes via MCP tools/list and tools/call.
FIPS mesh results include worker pubkey/npub, overlay address, transport endpoints, mesh health, DNS hostname, health, and projection status when available from persisted/projected state.
resources/list includes FIPS mesh resources while preserving DNS resources behavior.
Empty state returns empty lists/status rather than fake or demo data.
FIPS surfaces filter to FIPS/mesh records only.
